One hotel. Many possible futures.

Dealality helps hotel owners identify credible brand, operator, conversion, and strategic-partner paths, engage the right counterparties, and compare the options before committing.

Explore Your Hotel OpportunitySee How It Works
chunks.b:
The decision often starts too narrowly

The first conversation should not become the only option.

Hotel opportunities are often shaped through existing relationships, individual presentations, and sequential conversations. Valuable alternatives may remain unseen until momentum has already formed around one path.

  • Credible alternatives remain unexplored.
  • Proposals are evaluated on different assumptions.
  • Negotiating leverage declines as commitment builds.

A clearer path

See the opportunity before selecting the relationship.

Dealality brings the strategic paths, market responses, commercial terms, and decision criteria around one hotel opportunity into a single structured process.

  1. 01Explore credible paths
  2. 02Prepare the opportunity
  3. 03Engage the right counterparties
  4. 04Compare the trade-offs
  5. 05Make the decision
chunks.c:
Built around the decision

One opportunity. Every critical decision in view.

A connected owner workspace—from credible paths to comparable responses to negotiation priorities—around a single hotel opportunity.

Opportunity decision · Coastal Conversion

A · Credible strategic paths

  • Brand, operator, conversion, and partner alternatives
  • Shortlist reasoning with fit and non-fit notes
  • Evidence and remaining unknowns before outreach

B · Comparable market responses

  • Shared commercial and strategic criteria
  • Material differences between alternatives
  • Missing information surfaced early

C · Negotiation priorities and rationale

Unresolved termsPIP scope · territory · key-money timing
Priority itemsOperator fee structure · brand standards flexibility
Owner considerationsControl retention · conversion capital · timeline
Selected pathDocumented rationale ready for negotiation
  • Unresolved terms and priority gaps
  • Owner considerations kept explicit
  • Decision reasoning preserved with the opportunity
chunks.d:
Confidential. Owner-led. Human-guided.

Technology structures the process. Hospitality judgment guides the decision.

Dealality combines structured technology with hospitality judgment, owner-controlled participation, and selective information sharing. The owner determines which paths are explored, which parties are engaged, and what advances.

Confidential by design Sensitive information is organized and shared according to the needs of the process.

Owner-controlled The owner decides which paths are explored and which relationships advance.

Human-guided Technology supports research, organization, and comparison. Hospitality judgment remains central.

Dealality was developed from the realities of hotel brand, operator, development, conversion, and strategic-partner decisions, with the hospitality perspective of AO Hospitality Advisors.

Joan DeJarden, Founder
